consequence.statement: Kafka resources configured with `type: opa` authorization keep working in 0.46.0, but the Open Policy Agent authorization is deprecated and will be removed in a future release; the Open Policy Agent authorizer can instead be used through `type: custom` authorization.
consequence.remediation: Change the Kafka authorization from `type: opa` to `type: custom` to keep using the Open Policy Agent authorizer.

assertion.statement: The Open Policy Agent authorization (`type: opa` on the Kafka resource's authorization type field) has been deprecated and will be removed in a future release; the Open Policy Agent authorizer can be used through `type: custom` authorization instead.
